exposure.needed: whether the environment has DestinationRules on the same host with different ExportTo attributes

consequence.statement: DestinationRules on the same host with different ExportTo attributes will no longer be merged by default, which changes the routing behavior for such configurations unless the ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE environment variable is explicitly set to false.

assertion.statement: DestinationRule merging behavior for rules on the same host with different ExportTo attributes changed; merging is now disabled by default, but can be re-enabled by setting the ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE environment variable to false in the pilot deployment.
